feeds.title: Reading the Paranormal
feeds.description: A book review site dedicated to paranormal romance, urban fantasy, young adult and science fiction.

feeds.title: SmexyBooks » Paranormal Romance
feeds.description: Take a walk through the blog and learn more about their services, books, reviews, offers, recommendations, and much more. Smexy Books is a romance and urban fantasy review blog. They review all sub-genres as well as have guest posts and interviews with authors. They also enjoy smexy fictional men.

feeds.title: That's What I'm Talking About » Paranormal Romance
feeds.description: Visit their blog and learn more about paranormal, urban fantasy, all things romance, author interviews, giveaways, contests, audiobook resources, and more. That's What I'm Talking About primary focus is on Paranormal Romance and Urban Fantasy; however, they cover a range of genres including historical romance, LGBTQ, science fiction, steampunk, and more. Plus, author interviews, giveaways, and contests.

feeds.title: Paranormal Romance Guild
feeds.description: The Paranormal Romance Guild is the banding together of paranormal romance genre readers and writers, to support and promote new voices in PNR literature. The sole purpose is to support and promote all authors of the paranormal romance genre and their works through its website and the annual convention known as Paracon. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, books, reviews, interviews, and more about paranormal romance.

feeds.title: Uncaged Book Reviews
feeds.description: Uncaged Book Reviews is a monthly eMagazine, free-to-read, that gives support to Independent Authors and Small Publishing Houses.

feeds.title: Vampire Book Club
feeds.description: Established in 2010, this blog is for all those who love escaping into novels filled with vampires, shapeshifters, demons, witches and even the fae. While our preferences lean toward vampires, you'll see news and reviews from a variety of urban fantasy, paranormal romance and fantasy works both from the adult and young adult shelves.

feeds.title: Anna's Book Blog
feeds.description: The genre's I read are: Paranormal Romance, Urban Fantasy, Young Adult, Historical Romance and Fantasy. On this book blog, you'll find : Reviews Giveaways Author Interviews Guest Blogs Book News/Release Dates

feeds.title: Paranormal Tendencies
feeds.description: I am just someone that likes to read. A LOT. I am in no way a professional reviewer or blogger. I don't get paid for anything. I just enjoy reading for indie authors. And traditionally published authors too.

feeds.title: The Obsessive Bookseller » Urban Fantasy/Paranormal Books
feeds.description: Speculative Fiction Book Reviews by Niki Hawkes (for those in need of some seriously good reading). My website is where I review books (fantasy, science fiction, urban fantasy, and YA) talk about upcoming book releases, and host an online book club (Your Pick for Nik!).

feeds.title: Lovely Paranormal Books
feeds.description: Loving books until tomorrow comes. We love to promote less known authors as well as give our opinion on popular books.

feeds.title: Taking it One Book at a Time
feeds.description: Here to inspire people to read, take a step out of what you know, and pick up something new. I love paranormal, romance, mystery, urban fantasy, even some science fiction.

feeds.title: Harlequin Junkie » Paranormal Romance
feeds.description: Check out their blog and learn more about their services, books, reviews, features, media, and more on paranormal romance. HarlequinJunkie has a very robust and dedicated review crew aka HJ Junkies who are quite frankly book obsessed.

feeds.title: Literary Escapism
feeds.description: Literary Escapism is a book review site that features paranormal and fantasy literature including, but not limited to, Urban Fantasy, Paranormal Romance, YA Paranormal/Fantasy, Dark Fantasy, High Fantasy, Science Fiction and Romance.

feeds.title: Gothic Moms
feeds.description: Paranormal Book reviews for Gothic Moms and their kids, and so much more.

feeds.title: Myth and Magic Book Club
feeds.description: Myth and Magic Book Club was established in 2018. The books reviewed on this blog are primarily urban fantasy and paranormal romance, but you'll see a little bit of everything in the fantasy realm. We love witches, fae, vampires, shifters, and demons.
